task_a: Make old-style Markup formatting treat None as an empty optional value.
task_b: Reuse the old-style escape helper for simple Markup.format fields.
merge_result: Patch A and Patch B apply cleanly to the same base commit with git apply; no textual conflict is reported.
failure_summary: Patch A changes the old-style formatting helper so None is silently escaped as an empty string. Patch B routes simple new-style format fields through that helper. Together, Markup.format(None) stops rendering the literal text None, violating an existing formatting assumption that new-style formatting preserves Python's None stringification.
notes: First MarkupSafe seed instance and first test_assumption category instance. The interaction is between formatting-helper reuse and an implicit test expectation around None stringification.
